source_contract: 37 distinct local gallery painting images / 39 image-bearing catalogue records. Batch 06 added 9 previously owner-selected works from exact Cleveland CC0 and Met public-domain museum images, preserving source/photo hashes, 2000px uncropped derivative. One follower-of-Sodoma attribution discrepancy was held out of publication. No new prayer-card primary selection or changes to existing associations.

duplicate_same_original.note: The same physical image is referenced by two historical registry records, displayed once in gallery's image collection.
Two historical catalogue records refer to one physical Girardin painting and share one local image; prayer associations remain unchanged.

pending: 823 catalogue records remain metadata-only, including 1 owner-selected attribution-discrepancy hold (CANONICAL::cma-97147). Museum source JPEGs from Batch 06 are rights and hash verified but not claimed as permanently archived, unlike their hosted uncropped WebP derivatives. Prayer-stage image approval remains independent.
